cd /app && python -c "
from sentence_transformers import SentenceTransformer
m = SentenceTransformer('BAAI/bge-small-zh-v1.5', revision='7999e1d3359715c523056ef9478215996d62a620')
import numpy as np
texts = open('/app/data.txt').read().splitlines()
q = 'terminal-bench'
qe = m.encode([q], normalize_embeddings=True)
de = m.encode(texts, normalize_embeddings=True)
sims = de @ qe[0]
order = np.argsort(-sims)
for i in order[:5]:
    print(i+1, round(float(sims[i]),6), texts[i][:60])
open('/app/result.txt','w').write(texts[order[4]] + '\n')
"
